limits: Diagnostic only; no complete backend, Foundation, immutable baseline acceptance or fifteen-job acceptance manifest was run.
No same-host Task6 migration comparison or minimal-observer control was executed. Historic different-run or different-subset timings cannot establish causal source regression.
Inclusive phase timers overlap. Self time subtracts only timed descendants and can include recorder work. Thread CPU excludes other threads, workers and database server CPU.

Measured timer bookkeeping was 0.041496688 wall seconds and 0.048137017 thread CPU seconds; 10000 no-op wrapper calls took 0.045490377 wall seconds. Per-migration wrapper bookkeeping and indirect effects were not separately isolated.

Cursor counter measured overhead, hook overhead and sampler activity are numeric estimates; the cumulative sampling acquisition time overlaps test execution and must not be subtracted as additive cost.
The historical MinIO and Foundation failures remain independent unresolved acceptance blockers. Passing initialization here is not their acceptance.
The prepublication controls omitted the actual startup job environment. The resulting observed harness defect is documented, not repaired or retried under exhausted run authority.
measured_findings: Two original real-PostgreSQL migration tests passed, with zero failure/error/skip/xfail/xpass/deselection and no observer fault or truncation. The subprocess took 24.738114585 seconds under the unchanged 300-second subset limit.

The call phase observed 894 ProjectState.clone invocations, 2239 model reload invocations, 1910 model render invocations, five executor migrate invocations, 115 apply invocations and 28 unapply invocations.

Call-phase clone wall/thread CPU was 0.369036475/0.368125795 seconds. Model rendering was 13.36457648/13.335932229 seconds. Executor migrate was 15.480222159/14.93697878 seconds. Nested inclusive measurements overlap and cannot be summed.

Setup observed 441 clones and 849 renders; executor migrate wall/thread CPU was 5.469731709/5.05100171 seconds. This is pytest bootstrap, distinct from the two call-phase historical migration exercises.

Across setup and call, 202 apply invocations covered 1022 declared operation invocations, and 28 unapply invocations covered 142 declared operation invocations. Counts describe declared operations per delegated migration invocation, not a generalized full-suite cost.

In this selected candidate workload, rendering/reload consumed substantially more measured client-thread time than cloning. This identifies measured work, not a proven regression defect or a safe optimization.

All five PostgreSQL samples were available; no sampled lock/I/O/LWLock/ungranted-lock waits were positive. Five-second sampling cannot exclude short-lived waits. No sampled container throttling or OOM-kill increments were recorded.

The accepted Task6 startup classification remains unavailable because Job A stopped at its own control test. The original short startup failure and historical acceptance timeout causes remain unresolved.

prepublication_controls.limitation: The actual RECOVERY_JOB=startup environment was not tested before publication. The hosted startup control failure was then reproduced locally. Prepublication review did not catch this environment-dependent assertion.
